```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(alarmdata)
library(PL94171)
library(ggplot2)
library(redist)
library(ggredist)
library(sf)
options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r}
# ALARM data map of Texas
map_texas <- alarm_50state_map("TX")

#redist_map_texas <- redist_map(map_texas, existing_plan=cd_2020, pop_tol=0.01, total_pop = pop)
redist_texas_plans <- redist_smc(map_texas, nsims = 5)

redist.plot.plans(redist_texas_plans, draws=c("cd_2020", "1", "2", "3"), shp=map_texas)
```
